kind_why: Scene headings such as “SCENE 03 — THE UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER” frame acted events and character-labelled dialogue (“Kasun:”, “Anudi:”).
language_of_dialogue: Sinhala, with occasional English words and phrases.

problems.what: Sinhala vowel sign is placed before its consonant; should be “අනේ”.
Sinhala vowel sign precedes the consonant it belongs to; should be “වෙන්න”.
Missing consonant ග and displaced vowel sign; should be “ඔයාගේ”.
Multiple Sinhala vowel signs precede their consonants; should be “කෙනෙක්ගෙන්වත්”.
